_meta.description: State Tag F1 evaluation dataset. 17 multi-turn conversations covering all 4 visa types. Each conversation has a 'split': 'in_distribution' (the original 6, close to the tuned prompt distribution) or 'held_out' (11 novel scenarios — different professions, nationalities, input languages, boundary values — used to measure generalization). Expected tags use relaxed matching (id+status); value field is documentation for relaxed but is checked under strict matching. Forbidden tags are (type, id, status) patterns that must NOT appear.

splits.in_distribution: Original hand-tuned cases; reflect the prompt's training distribution.
splits.held_out: Novel surface forms of well-defined rules; the in_dist minus held_out prod-F1 gap is the generalization metric.

matching.relaxed: type + id + status must match (value ignored)
matching.strict: type + id + value + status must all match
